title: test_shell_form_launches asserts a 1.5 s wall-clock bound that a loaded Windows host misses, failing the sync gate at random
goal: TestLaunch::test_shell_form_launches proves the SessionEnd launcher returns without waiting for the distill (its point: the hook must not hold Claude Code's exit) by something a loaded host cannot break at random, such as the launcher returning before a planted slow distill finishes, or a bound taken relative to the host's own cost of starting sh and python; it passes on a Windows host running CI at the same time, and still fails when the launcher waits for the distill (planted).

run: import re,pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('_tools/test_querylog.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); m=re.search(r'def test_shell_form_launches.*?(?=\n    def )', t, re.S); sys.exit(1 if m and 'time.monotonic() - t0 < 1.5' in m.group(0) else 0)
